Premier League and La Liga players: what to expect in 2026/27

Every number here is a forecast for 2026/27, the season now under way. Built from 2025/26 data, not updated for games since. League moves come from 2026/27 appearances.

Who is in: outfield players by the role they started in most in 2025/26, read from every starting line-up. Strikers, wingers and 10s get shot and finishing ranges. Centre-backs, full-backs and central midfielders get ranges only for the stats that held up on a past season for their role. Use the filters to list a role, league or age group and sort by any stat.

The shots on target range passed on a second look at the same season, after a fix on 24 September 2026. 2026/27 is its first clean test.

Data sources: API-Football (season statistics, starting line-ups, injuries, transfers) and Understat (shots and xG, big five leagues only). A handful of transfers the feed had wrong or missing were checked by hand against club announcements and press reports.

Private by design. Every brief is inside this page. Your search runs in your browser only: nothing is sent anywhere and nothing is added to the address bar.
